subject: Media Literacy
title: Who Creates Propaganda
description: A quick, practical guide to Who Creates Propaganda.

hook.text: Governments, corporations, religions, activist groups — anyone with an agenda can create propaganda.

buildup.text: Propaganda isn't limited to dictatorships. Democracies use it too, especially during wartime and elections.

discovery.text: Edward Bernays, Freud's nephew, pioneered corporate propaganda and rebranded it as 'public relations.'

twist.text: Today, you don't need a government budget. A social media account and a viral strategy are enough.

climax.text: The democratization of media means the democratization of propaganda too.

punchline.text: Everyone has a megaphone now. Not everyone has good intentions.
